key_insight: The paper proves that, for a class of semilinear PDEs, DGM and PINN training with gradient descent converges to the true PDE solution rather than merely a local minimum of the residual loss.
engineering_relevance: This gives a rigorous foundation for using PINNs/DGM in scientific computing, increasing confidence that these neural solvers can be trusted for PDE-constrained engineering models.
method: Formulate PDE solving as minimizing a neural network residual objective.
Train the network with (stochastic) gradient descent.
Prove global convergence to the PDE solution for semilinear PDE classes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical convergence proof for neural networks trained on PDE residuals, rather than a numerical benchmark evaluation.
watch_item: The guarantee is limited to a class of semilinear PDEs, so it may not extend to more nonlinear, higher-dimensional, or poorly conditioned problems.
paper_title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
